candidates.title: Step-3 is Large yet Affordable: Model-system Co-design for Cost-effective Decoding
candidates.reason: Hardware-aware model-system co-design combines KV-reducing MFA attention with Attention-FFN disaggregation for low-cost MoE/VLM decoding, directly updating disaggregated serving and memory-efficiency lineages.

candidates.title: No Request Left Behind: Tackling Heterogeneity in Long-Context LLM Inference with Medha
candidates.reason: Medha co-designs fine-grained preemptive scheduling, adaptive chunking, stream pipeline parallelism, and KV-cache parallelism for heterogeneous long-context serving, directly matching scheduling and KV-memory lineages.

candidates.title: Online Scheduling for LLM Inference with KV Cache Constraints
candidates.reason: The work formulates LLM batching and scheduling under explicit KV-cache memory constraints and evaluates an online scheduler against hindsight-optimal and real-workload baselines, directly extending serving-scheduling research.

candidates.title: RAGCache: Efficient Knowledge Caching for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
candidates.reason: RAGCache introduces GPU/host multilevel caching of retrieved-knowledge intermediate states plus inference-aware replacement and retrieval/inference overlap, directly relevant to hierarchical memory and KV/state reuse.

candidates.title: TurboSpec: Closed-loop Speculation Control System for Optimizing LLM Serving Goodput
candidates.reason: TurboSpec dynamically controls speculative-decoding parallelism from runtime goodput feedback and integrates with vLLM, directly extending speculative-decoding and serving-control lineages.
